title: Team Relationships and Performance: Evidence from Healthcare Referral Networks
authors: Leila Agha; Keith M. Marzilli Ericson; Kimberley H. Geissler; James B. Rebitzer
eligible_reason: Treatment is continuous throughout. Main MA APCD and Medicare analyses are patient-level cross-sections of log spending on the PCP's jackknifed team referral concentration (JK_HHI_sawAvg, continuous HHI) with ZIP, specialty and physician/organization FE and patient risk controls. The Medicare mover design (13_MoverAnalysis_PlusQuality_raw_IV.do) is a patient-year panel of patients who move across HRRs, with patient FE, calendar-year FE and move-year-relative FE (i.moveyearp5), and the regressor post_deltaHHI_KG = post-move x continuous change in the PCP's referral concentration (event-time version: deltaHHI x relative-year dummies). Continuous treatment intensity, extra additive FE and an IV variant; no binary adoption indicator.
design_notes: MA APCD Replication/3_TeamsPaperCalculations (4-JKPatientLevelAnalyses-MainTables.do, 99-JKPatientLevelAnalysesPCPSPECHDFE.do): reghdfe lncln_totalspend JK_HHI_sawAvg i.specgroup patient_hhi patient controls, absorb(mem_zip [physician1Num / organization]), cluster(physician1Num). Medicare Replication/analytic_files/13_MoverAnalysis_PlusQuality_raw_IV.do: areg lncln_totalspend post_deltaHHI_KG [patient_hhi physician controls] i.fileyear i.moveyearp5 if normyr!=0, absorb(patid) cluster(patid); event-time version areg lncln_totalspend deltaHHI_KG_yrp* deltaHHI_KG_yrm* i.fileyear i.moveyearp5.
estimators_reported: OLS cross-section with continuous referral concentration and FE
mover design with patient FE and post x continuous delta HHI

specs.exclusion_reason: continuous treatment intensity (post x delta HHI) and extra additive FE (move-year relative FE)
specs.static_or_event: static and event-time (deltaHHI x relative year)

data_access: proprietary (Massachusetts All Payer Claims Database via CHIA application; research-identifiable 20% Medicare files via ResDAC; MHQP provider directory); only public crosswalks and NPPES files are shipped
data_provenance_note: Analysis data are restricted claims files not included in the package.
software_notes: Stata (reghdfe, areg), SAS for raw APCD processing, Python for network construction.
priority_note: Not a staggered binary design; data restricted.
screener_notes: Screened from the package only (no article text). Table numbers not determined from code; immaterial since no specification qualifies. No package code was run.
